preconditions.description: The input x is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: n >= 1 and all(all(A[i][j] == A[n - i - 1][j] and A[i][j] == A[i][n - j - 1] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The matrix A is symmetrical, meaning A[i][j] = A[n - i - 1][j] and A[i][j] = A[i][n - j - 1] for all i, j.

postconditions.expression: sum(sum(A[i][j] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n)) == int(stdin.strip())
postconditions.description: The sharpness of matrix A, which is the number of ones in the matrix, is equal to the input x.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i][j] * A[i][j + 1] == 0 and A[i][j] * A[i + 1][j] == 0 for i in range(n - 1) for j in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The matrix A is clear, meaning no two cells containing ones have a common side.
